rec-e1.subject: Sikugcinele indawo yakho kwa-Gadit
rec-e1.body:
Sawubona {name},

Uqale ukubhalisela i-{plan}, wama ngaphambi nje kokuthi uqede.

Sikugcinele konke, futhi ungaqhubeka khona kanye lapho ume khona.

- Izinsuku ezingu-14 mahhala, futhi akukho okukhokhiswayo namuhla
- Ngemva kwesivivinyo: {price}
- Sizokuthumelela isikhumbuzo nge-imeyili ngaphambi kokuthi isivivinyo siphele
- Ungakhansela noma nini ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti, ngokuchofoza kabili
rec-e1.next: Kukhona okungacacile? Vele uphendule le imeyili, sizokusiza.

rec-e2-family.subject: Lokho izingane zakho ezikutholayo kwa-Gadit
rec-e2-family.body:
Sawubona {name},

Besifuna ukukutshela kafushane ukuthi yini elinde izingane zakho kwa-Gadit:

Igama ngalinye ezihlangana nalo, encwadini, emsebenzini wasekhaya noma engxoxweni, liba yigama eziliqonda ngempela.

- Incazelo esezingeni lengane yakho, enesithombe sencazelo ngayinye
- Imidlalo nokuzijwayeza okwenziwe ngamagama azo
- Usizo ngomsebenzi wasekhaya
- Ideshibhodi yomzali ekukhombisa intuthuko yengane ngayinye

Ukubhalisela kwakho i-{plan} kugciniwe, futhi kusele isinyathelo sokugcina kuphela.
rec-e2-family.next: Akukho okukhokhiswayo namuhla, futhi ungakhansela noma nini ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti.

rec-e2-indiv.subject: Okukulindile kwa-Gadit
rec-e2-indiv.body:
Sawubona {name},

Besifuna ukukutshela kafushane ukuthi yini ekulindile kwa-Gadit:

Igama ngalinye, encwadini, emsebenzini noma engxoxweni, liba yigama oliqonda ngokuphelele.

- Zonke izincazelo zegama, ngesithombe sencazelo ngayinye
- Imidlalo nokuzijwayeza okwenziwe ngamagama akho
- Incwadi yakho yamagama egcina konke okufundile

Ukubhalisela kwakho i-{plan} kugciniwe, futhi kusele isinyathelo sokugcina kuphela.
rec-e2-indiv.next: Akukho okukhokhiswayo namuhla, futhi ungakhansela noma nini ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti.

rec-e3.subject: Kukhona okukuvimbile? Sitshele
rec-e3.body:
Sawubona {name},

Ukubhalisela kwakho i-{plan} kusagciniwe.

Uma kukhona okukubambezelayo, vele uphendule le imeyili, sizokusiza.

act-first-word-family.subject: Igama lokuqala lezingane zakho kwa-Gadit
act-first-word-family.body:
Sawubona {name},

Indlela engcono kakhulu yokuqala: hlala nengane yakho imizuzu emihlanu, nisesha igama elilodwa ehlangene nalo namuhla, encwadini, emsebenzini wasekhaya noma engxoxweni.

- Thayipha igama endaweni yokusesha
- Bona incazelo esezingeni lengane yakho, enesithombe sencazelo ngayinye
- Ligcine encwadini yamagama, bese lingena emidlalweni yayo

Igama elilodwa namuhla, futhi ingane yakho isivele yakha isilulumagama sayo.
act-first-word-family.next: Udinga usizo? Vele uphendule le imeyili.

act-first-word-indiv.subject: Igama lakho lokuqala kwa-Gadit
act-first-word-indiv.body:
Sawubona {name},

Indlela engcono kakhulu yokuqala: sesha igama elilodwa ohlangene nalo namuhla, encwadini, emsebenzini noma engxoxweni.

- Zonke izincazelo zalo, ngesithombe sencazelo ngayinye
- Ukuthi igama livelaphi
- Ligcine encwadini yakho yamagama bese uzijwayeza ngalo emidlalweni emifushane

Igama elilodwa namuhla, futhi isilulumagama sakho sesiyakhula.
act-first-word-indiv.next: Udinga usizo? Vele uphendule le imeyili.

act-first-word-2.subject: Igama elilodwa, imizuzu emihlanu
act-first-word-2.body:
Sawubona {name},

Umbono omncane wanamuhla: khetha igama elilodwa encwadini, emsebenzini wasekhaya noma ezindabeni, bese ulisesha kwa-Gadit.

Ngomzuzu nje ubona zonke izincazelo zalo, ngesithombe nezibonelo, futhi ligcinwa encwadini yamagama ukuze uzijwayeze.

Yile ndlela isilulumagama esikhula ngayo: igama elilodwa ngesikhathi.
act-first-word-2.next: Udinga usizo? Vele uphendule le imeyili.

act-add-child.subject: Esinye isinyathelo: engeza ingane yakho
act-add-child.body:
Sawubona {name},

I-Gadit Family yakhelwe izingane zakho, kodwa ayikho ingane esengezwe ku-akhawunti okwamanje. Kuthatha umzuzu:

- Thayipha igama lengane yakho bese ukhetha umlingiswa
- Xhuma idivayisi yayo ngaphandle kwephasiwedi, noma usebenzise Imodi yezingane kudivayisi yakho
- Kusukela lapho, igama ngalinye eliseshwa yingane yakho liyagcinwa, futhi ubona intuthuko kudeshibhodi yomzali
act-add-child.next: Udinga usizo? Vele uphendule le imeyili.

act-return-family.subject: Isiqalo esifushane kwa-Gadit, esenzelwe wena
act-return-family.body:
Sawubona {name},

Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zakho zithola konke i-Gadit engazinika khona. Nazi izinyathelo ezintathu ezimfushane zokuqala kuleli sonto:

- Engeza ingane ku-akhawunti, uma ungakakwenzi (umzuzu owodwa)
- Seshani ndawonye igama elilodwa encwadini noma emsebenzini wasekhaya
- Vula imidlalo, eyenziwe ngamagama agcinwe yingane yakho
act-return-family.next: Ufuna sikukhombise ukuthi isebenza kanjani? Phendula le imeyili, sizohlela ucingo olufushane lwemizuzu eyi-10.

act-return-indiv.subject: Isiqalo esifushane kwa-Gadit, esenzelwe wena
act-return-indiv.body:
Sawubona {name},

Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola konke i-Gadit engakunika khona. Nazi izinyathelo ezintathu ezimfushane zokuqala kuleli sonto:

- Sesha igama elilodwa ohlangene nalo namuhla
- Ligcine encwadini yakho yamagama
- Zijwayeze amagama akho emidlalweni emifushane
act-return-indiv.next: Ufuna sikukhombise ukuthi isebenza kanjani? Phendula le imeyili, sizohlela ucingo olufushane lwemizuzu eyi-10.
